up: List all approved drugs whose mechanism of action is classified as partial agonist. For each drug, include the target ChEMBL ID, target name, target organism, drug ChEMBL ID, drug preferred name, and canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS drug_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM drug_mechanism dm
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE dm.action_type = 'PARTIAL AGONIST' AND md.max_phase = 4;
